expectedRealization.rationale: Installation and grid-investment trends can influence inverter/equipment demand within one or two quarters.

changeHypothesis.summary: China solar installations and grid investment remained very strong and recovered after a mid-year policy transition, but installation volume did not translate uniformly into inverter/company profit, making the earnings bridge company-specific rather than sector-wide.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Official NEA data showed very high cumulative solar additions and rising grid investment.
disconfirmingEvidence: Solar overcapacity and price competition can separate volume growth from profit growth.
Q3 company results diverged materially across inverter suppliers.
Policy changes can pull demand forward or change project economics.

evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: Official data showed strong solar capacity/additions and higher grid investment.

锦浪科技 Q3 profit fell despite the same broad installation environment.

causalChain.mechanism: New installations require inverters, storage/grid equipment and related systems.
causalChain.failureMode: Policy transition slows projects or inventory/channel effects absorb demand.

causalChain.mechanism: Profit depends on product mix, overseas exposure, pricing and cost structure rather than installation volume alone.
causalChain.failureMode: Price competition and margin compression offset shipment growth.

falseThemeMatches: solar-volume beneficiaries with no margin/earnings sensitivity

selectionComparison.rationale: Official deployment strength is real, but stock-level earnings transmission is too heterogeneous to select a company from this event alone.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Strong solar/storage activity was already visible; leading companies had already reported strong earnings.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Deployment can remain strong, but no new differentiated company-level expectation gap is established from the official volume data alone.
expectations.measurableGap: Opportunity-level evidence is insufficient to distinguish a stock winner.

constraints: Do not infer alpha from installation volume alone.

nextResearchActions: Keep at Research hypothesis; require a separate company-specific catalyst before selection.
